gaps: The draft prohibits a preliminary draft PR while accepted Decision 0054 permits one before unavailable platform observations and the old plan requires a checkpoint.
The draft permits coordinator transfer with a different-task required round open while Decision 0053 prohibits transfer during any partially completed question exchange.
The specification says it avoids duplicating the delivery graph while assigning most of that graph beyond the two declared ownership constraints.
Native grill passage is undefined between optional structured questions, ordinary chat, the current one-round floor, and the intended no-forced-question outcome.
The new artifact_digest identity cannot follow the grill flow because questions bind revision A while the recorded grill binds amended revision B, and composite digest sources are undefined.
Ordinary-chat authority claims exact answer records that current approval and decision artifacts do not independently contain.
The handoff double-read cannot prove a coherent snapshot, permits ABA changes, and omits marker-on-refreshed-trunk and green-CI ownership completion.
Cross-lens finding identity lacks deterministic normalization, exact applicability grammar, remediation ownership, and acceptance coverage.
Context partitioning proves byte coverage without semantic aggregation and does not bind one immutable external-file snapshot.
Active-task review migration demands marker and seal provenance that an active unsealed task cannot have, and global preflight before first mutation is unstated.
Genuine native contribution remains self-attested because existing measurement proves changed bytes but not that the delta implements the cited criterion or review fix.
Retention acceptance omits exact filename/payload ID equality and content-identical durable readback before deletion.
Review lifecycle cardinality is ambiguous between one operation, one helper invocation, post-fix assessments, and another fresh formal review.
Hook failure evidence has no named producer, record family, reader, or gate consequence, and Stop currently fails open without proof.
The final no-evidence-schema-or-review-protocol claim is too broad because the body extends structured-round and selected-review evidence families.
resolutions: Accepted Decision 0054 remains active. The selected structured answer makes one draft PR CI transport only when a required platform row cannot run otherwise; it creates no preliminary formal review or proof. After the report passes, one fresh formal generation runs, the task seals, and the same draft is promoted. The amended plan deletes the mandatory preliminary-inspection block.

The selected structured answer preserves accepted Decision 0053. Dependency-ready unaffected work may continue, but coordinator transfer waits until every required exchange for the story is answered or cancelled without authority.

The final body removes task names for workflow, native lifecycle, question, Format, Quality and Integration responsibilities. Only the user-set First D-0032 and Portable one-time migration constraints remain; plan and decomposition own the complete graph.

The final body states the transition explicitly: incumbent floors remain until the question-provenance task ships; afterward a ledgered native cold read may use zero rounds only for a fully mapped empty frontier, while a human frontier cites an eligible structured round or accepted decision/approval record and event without synthesis.

The identity now carries question_input_digest from issuance revision A. The final grill separately binds amended revision B plus the resolution mapping, and every gate reuses its canonical brief/recorder digest producer.

The final body defines the owning command as authority. Approval records the boolean against exact digest and developer identity; decision acceptance uses the decision revision plus its same-operation event. Free-text/multi-option choices require an eligible gate round or accepted decision body/event; chat is not a second ledger.

The final body requires refreshed trunk plus one protected-state lock shared by all relevant mutators, a monotonic generation, safe exact byte identities, the task marker on refreshed trunk, green CI for that commit, seal, no worker and all required exchanges closed. Any drift or unsafe state refuses before transfer.

The final body fixes one remediation-owning lens tag, RFC 8785 canonical JSON, NFC normalization, safe repository-relative slash paths, integer/null line, lowercase category, Unicode White_Space collapse, unique finding records, exact AFFECTS fingerprint BLOCKING or NONBLOCKING lines, material-effect meaning and focused normalization/applicability tests.

The final body opens each input once without unsafe links, captures immutable UTF-8 bytes plus hash/count, requires known byte limits, launches only captured bytes, and permits partitions only for a declared ordered all-or-nothing aggregation contract.

The final body requires one global preflight before any target write and distinguishes exact active-unsealed bindings with no marker/seal from sealed bindings with committed marker/seal/commit. Mixed state and any invalid member refuse without mutation.

The final body binds a registration-time product-tree before/after delta to a criterion or review finding and requires the selected independent review generation to verify that exact contribution. Comments, formatting-only changes and proof metadata do not qualify.

The final body requires filename stem equal validated event ID, preserves the parsed payload, and compares deterministic compact UTF-8 canonical payload content-identically with the just-read durable entry before source deletion.

The final body defines one task review lifecycle with immutable generations. Each initial or post-fix default run invokes the helper once; a blocking generation publishes and revokes clean state, and only the selected clean generation certifies proof.

The final body uses the existing event family for adapter-event-result records binding runtime, row, owner, outcome, host blocking capability and task/session identity. The adapter hook produces them and shared task proof consumes them; an unrecordable failure cannot pass, and documented Stop fail-open never becomes successful continuation proof.

The final sentence now permits additive fields and task-scoped selection within existing question, event and review evidence families while forbidding a parallel permission source, second registry or separate review procedure.
